# Love2moon

Love2moon is a daily companion app for couples. It offers quizzes, games, relationship prompts, mood check-ins, and small gifts to help partners stay connected.

## Homepage

- https://love2moon.app/

## Key public pages

- https://love2moon.app/ — Marketing homepage and app entry point
- https://love2moon.app/sign-in — Sign in to an existing account
- https://love2moon.app/sign-up — Create a new account

## About

Love2moon is designed for two people in a relationship. After signing up, each partner pairs with the other using an invite code. The shared experience includes daily check-ins, relationship games, date-idea suggestions, and a gifting feature.
